name: AiPDF Editor
tagline: A complete PDF editor — edit text, redact, OCR scans, organize pages — with AI that reads your documents.
description:
AiPDF Editor is a full PDF workspace that runs entirely inside your Anna window. Open a PDF from your computer and work on it locally in the app: the document is parsed and edited in the window itself and is only written back when you save.

WHAT IT DOES

• View — fast pdf.js rendering, thumbnails, bookmarks/outline, zoom, dark mode, measurement rulers with draggable guides.
• Comment & markup — highlights, underline, squiggly, sticky notes, shapes, free-hand ink, text boxes and callouts, stamps, signatures, images. Real PDF annotations that render in any reader.
• Edit — Acrobat-style direct text editing with a full format panel (fonts, size, colour, alignment, spacing), table-aware cell-scoped edits, object editing (move/resize/rotate/replace), watermarks, headers/footers, Bates numbering, page backgrounds, layers written as real optional-content groups.
• Organize — insert, delete, rotate, extract, reorder, merge and split pages.
• Forms — read and fill AcroForm fields, create new fields, export values to JSON/CSV.
• Protect — AES-256 encryption with granular permissions, verified redaction (every mark is checked against the saved bytes), security removal.
• OCR — offline Tesseract recognition for scanned pages (English, Nepali, Hindi). The AI-vision engine uses Anna's host model.
• Trust tools — document forensics (embedded scripts, incremental-update history), a PDF/UA + WCAG accessibility checker, and an egress ledger.
• Read aloud — local browser voice, play/pause, speed control, page tracking.

AI FEATURES (POWERED BY ANNA)

The assistant runs on Anna's host model — no API key needed; usage counts against your Anna credits: summarize, translate, proofread, rewrite selections, ask questions about the open document (or all open documents at once) with [p.N] citations, AI contract review with risk flags, AI smart redaction of sensitive data, AI document outline, and AI-vision OCR for difficult scans.

PRIVACY MODEL

Your PDF never leaves the window: parsing, editing, redaction and OCR happen locally in the app. Only the text you explicitly send to an AI feature goes to the Anna host model. Files are opened and saved through your browser's file dialogs.

NOTES FOR THE ANNA EDITION

OCR uses the bundled fast English/Nepali/Hindi language packs; read-aloud uses your browser's built-in voice; version backups and printing differ slightly from the Windows desktop edition of AiPDF Editor (open source, MIT: github.com/manjayofficial01-ui/AiPDF).
